capabilities: Highlight exact selections in Reading View using surrounding context
Apply six native highlight colours via a floating toolbar or hotkeys
Search, recolour, remove, merge, and undo highlights from a current-note navigator
Convert older HTML highlights to native highlight markup
extras: Listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Several features from earlier versions (tag management, footnote annotation, PDF support, exports, reading progress) are no longer included. Optional terminal installer and release verification require Python 3.9+ and Node.js.
intentEvidence: Reader Highlighter Tags settings are migrated and that plugin is disabled, with its files retained.
problem: Highlighting in Reading View is imprecise, so selecting part of a sentence, list item, or table cell is hard to mark and manage reliably.
